description: flow — (1) .todo is the user's parking lot: deny agent writes to it (PreToolUse), with per-session arming when the user says ALLOW TODO (UserPromptSubmit); deferrals go to .todo-inbox; kill-switch TODO_GUARD_DISABLE=1 (one-shot TODO_GUARD_SKIP=1). (2) SessionStart re-stamps <claude-config>/plugins/data/optimiziramsi-skills/current at the running plugin so every repo's .agent/bin/{loop,grind} symlinks follow a plugin update; creates nothing; kill-switch FLOW_LINK_OFF=1.
